verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents a `skills list` (alias `ls`) command for installed skills, similar to `npm ls`, and a `skills remove` command that can target specific agents. The clean-removal part of the story is not shown. Nothing says removal deletes the canonical copy behind the recommended symlinks, and there is no hands-on test of a removal. A community complaint that uninstalls are undocumented is general skepticism, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented guarantee that remove cleans up canonical copies and symlinks with no orphaned files, evidence that no instructions linger in agent configs after removal, hands-on removal corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions

citations.quote: List all installed skills. Similar to `npm ls`.
npx skills remove --agent claude-code cursor my-skill
